description: This Java class, DefaultMetricsReporterConfig, provides the default implementation for health check metrics reporter configuration within the Eclipse Ditto project. It encapsulates configuration parameters such as resolution duration and history size, with factory methods to instantiate from a Typesafe Config object.

classes.name: DefaultMetricsReporterConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MetricsReporterConfig, providing configuration for metrics reporter such as resolution and history.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultMetricsReporterConfig from a Config object, applying fallback logic.

methods.name: getResolution
methods.description: Returns the resolution duration for the metrics.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns the history size for metrics retention.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare configuration instances.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() based on resolution and history.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration.
